name: order_item_id
description: Surrogate order line identifier, format ITM00000001.

name: line_number
description: 1-based line number within the order; (order_id, line_number) is unique.

name: product_id
description: FK to products.product_id. A product appears at most once per order.

name: unit_price
description: Price per unit charged on this order (equals product list_price in this version).

name: net_amount
description: gross_amount - discount_amount. Merchandise value after discount, excludes tax and shipping.
